Row.Text: 选择白绮后，内政、生产、建造与和平扩张永久由AI执行，支付正常成本；玩家只能查看，军队由你指挥。[NEWLINE]选中相邻陆军，直接右键与敌城交互：击破外防且城市生命不高于35%时，可确认支付金币征取城市，并结束该军队本回合行动。

Administration, production, construction and peaceful expansion are permanently delegated at normal costs. You inspect cities and command the army.[NEWLINE]Right-click an adjacent enemy city with eligible land troops. With outer defenses broken and city health at 35% or less, confirm the gold cost to requisition the city and end this unit's movement.
白绮，令城市为你运转，率军亲临战场。为我前驱。
Baiqi, let your cities work while you lead the army. Go forth for me.
